sources.title: Sudoku-Bench - pub.sakana.ai
sources.snippet: Sudoku-Bench in its current form is best suited for benchmarking LLM reasoning models. Sudoku variants are not suitable for certain non-LLM reasoning models (e.g., HRM or TRM) without an explicit LLM module of some kind. We present text-only representations of all puzzles in Sudoku-Bench.
